text:
maya_sales: Hey team — new inbound from VentureCorp. They're doing a POC and have an initial SIG/CAIQ and DPA checklist. asking for a quick rundown of what we can sign off on and what needs legal review. timeline: POC next week.

own_eng: Cool, do they want logs/payload retention details for the POC? usually we provide a 30-day retention by default unless they request otherwise.

sam_security: @maya_sales can you attach their questionnaire? need to see specific CAIQ sections. Common blockers: env isolation, data deletion, and key management.

maya_sales: attaching the first pass from their infosec (paste below):

---
1) Do you support per-customer data deletion within 30 days of request?
2) Can you run the POC inside our cloud region (EU-west) or provide a dedicated tenant?
3) Which encryption-at-rest and KMS options are supported?
4) Do you have a CAIQ / SIG report?
---

leah_privacy: For #1 we need to be precise — we can delete PII from our hosted logs on request but cached KV/embeddings may persist until garbage-collected. propose language: `Redwood will remove customer-provided content from primary storage within 30 days of validated deletion request; backups and caches will be purged as part of routine retention and may take up to 90 days.`

sarah_legal: That clause is reasonable. Add: `Customer is responsible for ensuring prompts do not include third-party personal data without consent.` Also need to confirm Scope in DPA for subprocessors (cloud infra providers).

own_eng: For POC env we can spin a dedicated VPC private deployment but needs lead time — 72 hours earliest. For hosted POC we can pin model versions and enable prefix KV caching off by default.

sam_security: On CAIQ — we have a current SIG self-assessment but not full attestation for all modules. I can share the latest export, but for their vendor risk form we should map our answers to their control IDs.

maya_sales: They also asked about DSAR handling and whether we accept direct DSAR routing.

leah_privacy: We accept DSARs routed through the customer. If they want Redwood to handle end-user DSARs directly we need a signed Data Processing Addendum with explicit processing instruction and a workflow described. Example: `Redwood will process verified DSARs forwarded by Controller within 30 days; Redwood will not proactively accept direct consumer requests unless authorized.`

sam_security: Quick ask for @owen_eng — can you confirm encryption stack: AES-256 at rest, TLS1.2+ in transit, and KMS integrations with AWS KMS / GCP KMS? Also note hardware HSM optional for private deployments.

own_eng: Confirmed: AES-256, TLS1.2+ (TLS1.3 preferred), AWS/GCP KMS supported, customer-managed keys for Private installs, and HSM support via partner integrations. I'll paste the short snippet you can copy into the SIG response:

```
Encryption: Data in transit protected via TLS1.2+ (TLS1.3 preferred). At rest encryption via AES-256. Customer-managed keys (CMK) supported through AWS KMS and GCP KMS. On-prem/private deployments can be integrated with customer HSM/KMS.
```

maya_sales: Perfect — @sarah_legal can you check the DPA additions and approve? we need final language by EOD so sales can accept their security questionnaire mapping tomorrow.

sarah_legal: Reviewing now. One redline: tighten the backup purge timeframe to 60 days instead of 90. propose: `backups and caches may take up to 60 days to be purged` — pinging compliance for confirmation.

deploy-bot: Deployment request #4521 queued — env provisioning estimated start in 72h if approved.

leah_privacy: Also recommend we add an example request flow for DSARs in the POC runbook so VentureCorp knows how to test deletion behaviors. small template: `1) Controller sends validated deletion request to Redwood Support with controller reference; 2) Redwood acknowledges; 3) deletion executed and confirmed within 30 days; 4) final confirmation with retention log.`

maya_sales: Thanks all. Plan: 1) @owen_eng share the encryption snippet into the CAIQ mapping doc, 2) @sam_security map controls and export SIG, 3) @sarah_legal finalize DPA tone (60d backup purge), 4) @leah_privacy add DSAR runbook fragment, 5) I'll coordinate POC timing with VentureCorp (aim for Wed). Anyone object? :thumbsup:

sam_security: :thumbsup:

own_eng: +1

sarah_legal: +1 (pending compliance sign-off)

maya_sales: Great — looping @venturecorp-security (external) in next message with the runbook and CAIQ stub. will update thread when they reply.
